clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 269 specifies requirements for 33-grade Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC). This is the basic cement standard. Higher grade cements are covered by IS 8112 (43-grade OPC) and IS 12269 (53-grade OPC). ALL cement sold in India must mandatorily carry the ISI mark — cement is one of the items under compulsory BIS certification.

clauses.title: Chemical Composition Requirements
clauses.text:
Chemical requirements for OPC (IS 269):
- Lime Saturation Factor: 0.66 to 1.02
- Insoluble Residue: Not more than 4.0%
- Magnesia (MgO): Not more than 6.0%
- Sulphuric Anhydride (SO3): Not more than 3.5%
- Total Loss on Ignition: Not more than 5.0%
- Compressive strength at 28 days: Not less than 33 MPa (33-grade)
